ruleDefinitions.name: VMGuestLib DLL Sideload
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects DLL sideloading of VMGuestLib.dll by the WmiApSrv service. Note: Unmapped fields: ImageLoaded, Signed

sequences.query: ((ImageLoaded = RGX(".*\\\\VMware\\\\VMware\\ Tools\\\\vmStatsProvider\\\\win32.*") AND ImageLoaded = RGX(".*\\\\vmGuestLib\\\.dll.*")) AND process_path = RGX("\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\wbem\\\\WmiApSrv\\\.exe$")) AND  NOT (Signed = "true")
